We need to compare laptop quotations (RFQ-2026-014). We have four vendors: Acme, Orbital, BrightPath, Nimbus. We need to compare total delivered price, lead time, warranty. Then find cheapest vendor. Then search web for recent reviews of that cheapest vendor and summarize them. End with line 'Best price: <vendor>'.

We have data from files. Let's parse each:

Acme: unit 742, qty 50 => subtotal 37,100. Shipping 450. Total delivered 37,550. Lead time 14 business days. Warranty 3 years on-site.

Orbital: unit 760, qty 50 => list total 38,000. Volume discount 4% for orders over 40 units => 4% of 38,000 = 1,520. So discounted total 36,480. Shipping included. Total delivered 36,480. Lead time 10 business days. Warranty 3 years on-site.

BrightPath: unit 715, qty 50 => line total 35,750. Shipping 0. Total delivered 35,750. Lead time 21 calendar days. Warranty 2 years on-site.

Nimbus: unit 728, qty 50 => 36,400. Express shipping 300. Total delivered 36,700. Lead time 7 business days. Warranty 3 years on-site.

So cheapest total delivered price is BrightPath at 35,750. Next Orbital 36,480. Nimbus 36,700. Acme 37,550.

Thus cheapest vendor BrightPath. Need to search web for recent reviews of BrightPath. We already did search: result 1 is BrightPath Systems - customer reviews URL: https://reviews.example/vendors/brightpath-systems. Let's retrieve that page.
